papers.title: Visible Touch：将触觉接触信号渲染进视觉空间以赋能视觉运动策略
papers.titleEn: Visible Touch: Rendering Contact for Visuomotor Policies
papers.summary: 触觉对精密操作至关重要，但多数预训练VLA与视觉运动策略只接受图像与本体状态，强行外挂触觉编码器往往破坏原有视觉骨干。Visible Touch提出把低成本磁触觉传感器的逐单元接触信号直接投影渲染到RGB图像同一空间坐标系中，使任意图像条件策略（含微调VLA）无需改结构即可利用触觉信息。思路简洁通用，但依赖相机与指尖标定精度且难以表达复杂剪切力矩。
papers.summaryEn: Touch is critical for robust manipulation, yet modern pretrained VLAs accept only images and proprioception, and bolting on separate tactile encoders breaks image-conditioned backbones. Visible Touch renders per-taxel readings from a low-cost magnetic contact sensor directly as spatial overlays in the policy’s RGB frame, letting any image-conditioned policy or fine-tuned VLA exploit contact without architectural changes. It is clean and plug-and-play, though sensitive to camera-finger calibration and limited for complex shear torques.
papers.whySelected: CoRL 2026 Spotlight；用“把触觉画进图像空间”的巧妙接口设计，零改动赋能主流视觉运动与 VLA 策略。

papers.title: OASIS：通过 SE(3) 轨迹预测对齐视觉运动策略的观测与动作空间
papers.titleEn: OASIS: Observation-Action Space Alignment via SE(3) Trajectory Prediction for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: 现有VLA和世界动作模型虽引入视觉特征或未来图像预测，但中间表征仍停留在观测空间，迫使动作解码器隐式恢复刚体几何。OASIS融合视觉语言与公制深度构建3D感知编码器，并以相机坐标系下末端SE(3)轨迹预测作为显式中间任务，再用姿态监督隐状态引导动作解码，在仿真与真机操作上均取得稳健增益。该设计几何直觉扎实，但高度依赖深度估计精度与刚体末端假设。
papers.summaryEn: Existing VLAs and world action models enrich representations in observation space without matching the rigid-body geometry of action space. OASIS fuses vision-language and metric-depth features into a 3D-aware encoder paired with an explicit camera-frame SE(3) end-effector trajectory predictor whose pose-supervised hidden states condition the action decoder, improving simulation and real manipulation. The geometric alignment is principled, though dependent on metric depth quality and rigid end-effector assumptions.
papers.whySelected: NeurIPS 2026 Spotlight；清晰剖析观测空间与动作空间几何失配问题，用相机系 SE(3) 轨迹预测做强结构桥梁。

papers.title: MolmoMotion：语言指令引导的世界坐标系3D点轨迹预测
papers.titleEn: MolmoMotion: Forecasting Point Trajectories in 3D with Language Instruction
papers.summary: 让智能体预测物体在未来如何随指令运动是规划与物理推理的基础。MolmoMotion将任务形式化为目标条件3D点轨迹预测：输入短视觉历史、物体3D查询点与语言指令，预测各点在公制世界坐标下的未来运动，并开源百万级数据集MolmoMotion-1M与评测集PointMotionBench。该本体无关3D运动先验能有效迁移至机器人规划与视频可控生成，但复杂遮挡与接触力建模仍较薄弱。
papers.summaryEn: Anticipating how objects move under language goals is central to embodied planning. MolmoMotion formalizes goal-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting in metric world coordinates from RGB history, query points, and text instructions, releasing the 1.16M-clip MolmoMotion-1M corpus and PointMotionBench. This embodiment-agnostic 3D prior transfers cleanly to robot planning and controllable video generation, though heavy occlusion and explicit contact-force physics remain challenging.
papers.whySelected: NeurIPS 2026 Spotlight；以世界坐标3D点轨迹打通人类视频、机器人操作规划与可控视频生成，且开放百万级数据与代码。

papers.title: M2-ResiPolicy：融合自适应触觉与力混合控制的主微残差精细操作架构
papers.titleEn: Master–Micro Residual Correction With Adaptive Tactile Fusion and Force-Mixed Control for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters（RA-L 2026 · Vol. 11 No. 11 · 正式发表）
papers.summary: 接触密集型精细操作同时要求长时程全局规划与高频局部抗滑响应，单一视觉扩散策略往往频率过低且盲于摩擦突变。M2-ResiPolicy提出双流主微架构：10Hz主引导策略以置信门控交叉注意力融合视触觉生成全局动作块，高频微残差模块实时修偏并由力混合柔顺控制器执行，在插拔与易碎精细操作上表现稳健。双层训练流程相对复杂，传感器标定维护成本亦较高。
papers.summaryEn: Contact-rich manipulation demands both global task coherence and high-frequency slip/friction reaction, which low-rate visual diffusion policies struggle to balance. M2-ResiPolicy decouples a 10 Hz Master-Guidance diffusion policy using confidence-gated visuotactile cross-attention from a reactive high-frequency Micro-Residual correction module executed via force-mixed compliant control. It excels on fine contact tasks, though staged training complexity and tactile sensor calibration remain non-trivial.
papers.whySelected: IEEE RA-L 2026 年 11 月期正式发表；清华/中山/南洋理工团队以双时间尺度主微残差+力混合控制扎实攻克接触密集型操作。

papers.title: SEVI：基于证据不确定性安全评论家的真机在线安全强化学习
papers.titleEn: SEVI: Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters（RA-L 2026 · Vol. 11 No. 12 · 正式发表）
papers.summary: 直接在物理机器人上跑在线强化学习能攻克接触密集任务，但探索期的不安全碰撞极易损毁硬件。SEVI引入单次前向即可同时估计未来违规风险与认知不确定性的证据安全评论家：每步执行前若预测风险过高或证据支持不足，即无缝切换至离线训练的安全恢复策略，显著降低USB插拔等真机在线训练中的危险碰撞。其安全边界仍取决于离线安全标注覆盖度与阈值设定。
papers.summaryEn: Online real-world RL enables contact-rich manipulation directly on hardware, yet unsafe exploratory actions risk physical damage. SEVI introduces an Evidential Safety Critic that estimates both future violation risk and epistemic uncertainty in a single forward pass; before executing any task-policy action, elevated risk or low evidential support triggers an offline recovery policy, cutting unsafe contacts on real USB insertion. Safety guarantees still hinge on offline safety-label coverage and threshold tuning.
papers.whySelected: IEEE RA-L 2026 年 12 月期正式发表；用单次前向证据不确定性实时拦截高风险真机 RL 探索，实用价值突出。

阈值设置过严会频繁触发恢复而拖慢在线学习效率，过宽则会遗漏边缘碰撞风险。 / Overly conservative thresholds slow online exploration while loose thresholds risk missed collisions.

papers.title: 带否定 Datalog 的 Why(-Not) 溯源语义与复杂性分析
papers.venue: KR 2026 · Main Track（正式发表 · pp. 201–210）
papers.summary: 正Datalog的why-provenance已有充分研究，但引入否定后的溯源语义与复杂性长期空白。本文基于论证理论，将why(-not)溯源拓展至良基与稳定模型语义下的带否定Datalog，并证明两种语义下解释判定的数据复杂性均为NP-完全，与正Datalog同级而未恶化。成果填补了非单调规则可解释性的理论缺口，暂未涉及大规模求解引擎实现。
papers.summaryEn: While why-provenance for positive Datalog is well studied, its counterpart for Datalog with negation remained open. Building on justification theory, this paper extends why(-not)-provenance to Datalog with negation under both well-founded and stable model semantics and establishes its data complexity, proving NP-completeness in both cases—matching positive Datalog without extra blowup. It closes a key theoretical gap in non-monotonic rule explainability, without addressing large-scale engine implementation.
papers.whySelected: KR 2026 主会核心理论长文；直接把 why(-not)-provenance 推进到带否定的非单调 Datalog 推理，高度贴合李的溯源与知识表示主线。
